Dear Madam
I expect to receive the Policy from the Norwich Union Office in a day or two & will then forward it to [Mrs. Yonge](/person/1604)as you wish. You know of course that at the present time the Policy is absolutely your property & stands in your name with the Company
I am yours faithy
[Chas Wooldridge](/person/2094)
Miss Yonge
Lady Seaton’s[Beechwood](/place/126) Devon
